source_findings: Hardcoded model/hash profiles and scalar speed_clamp_lo edits; no THR profile found.
0x80000 input selects 0x6C000 payload; packaging starts at 0x4000. THR RWD starts at 0xC000 with 0x74000 payload.
Checksum writing loop uses sum/negative sum; no repair of the identified THR runtime CRC slots in this script.
conclusion: No demonstrated THR-specific zero-speed implementation preserving special standstill entry/release behavior. Existing THR special path is distinct from lowering normal minimum speed. No firmware modified.
